purpose: Durable index of passing automated evidence that is narrower than exact-candidate production certification.

status_policy.note: This overlay cannot certify a matrix row. The canonical release gate remains closed until exact-release, live-environment evidence and independent review update the main matrix.

evidence.environment: Three real durable fiducia-node Raft processes behind the real fiducia-load-balance process, with immutable node/LB/routing/interface/test-config revisions.
assertions: Two organizations using the same raw KV key receive only their own value through edge to load balancer to node.
Two organizations can independently hold the same raw lock key without sharing ownership authority.
Same raw anchor keys and prefix-list responses remain tenant scoped and omit the other tenant's values and internal scope prefix.
limitations: Local process composition, not the exact production image digests or external ingress.
Does not yet cover project/environment scopes, customer API-key issuance, live network policy, globally complete cross-shard listing, or independent reviewer acceptance.

evidence.environment: Three real durable fiducia-node Raft processes behind the real fiducia-load-balance process.
assertions: Direct-node requests with missing, wrong, edge-only, bearer-only, or duplicated internal credentials are denied.
Denied direct-node writes do not appear when reconciled through the authoritative load-balanced read path.
limitations: Does not prove Kubernetes NetworkPolicy, public ingress reachability, peer-port policy, or exact production secrets/certificates.
No packet capture or independent live-environment review is attached yet.

evidence.environment: Locked fiducia-auth Rust CI exercising the public verifier/cache/revocation-record contract without external services or secret material.
assertions: Exact-token revocations are bounded by issuer, audience, tenant, JTI, and expiry.
Subject quarantine remains tenant and subject scoped across replacement tokens.
Equal JTI values in different tenants do not share revocation cache authority.
A cold verifier with an unavailable authority fails closed and cannot return Allowed.
Revocation storage keys are opaque, fixed size, tenant separated, and target-kind separated.
limitations: Source-level verifier proof only; it does not measure multi-process cache propagation through every supported ingress.
Restart, partition, authoritative rotation, the proposed 60-second bound, exact-release deployment, and independent review remain pending.

evidence.environment: Real fiducia-load-balance and three real fiducia-node processes using the pinned trusted-hop contract.
assertions: The load balancer rejects node-plane credentials, wrong or duplicated edge credentials, missing organization identity, and duplicated organization identity.
The load balancer strips a client-supplied node credential and injects its canonical trusted-hop credential.
limitations: Does not yet exercise an external CDN/edge product, malicious DNS, unregistered redirect targets, or production egress policy.
The exact production release and live packet/evidence bundle remain pending.

evidence.environment: Three real durable fiducia-node Raft processes at node candidate 06bbda3efd18d1e791bf933047f6baf28984959e behind the real fiducia-load-balance process; the workflow also ran the focused node policy unit test before route-level tests.
assertions: An ordinary kv:write identity receives HTTP 403 for plaintext:true and the canary remains absent from authoritative reads.
Wildcard data-plane authority is not admin plaintext authority and cannot persist the canary.
Explicit admin:write can opt out only for a non-secret key and readback reports plaintext protection metadata.
The reserved secret keyspace rejects plaintext:true even with explicit admin authority.
The stable denial response does not echo the submitted canary value.
limitations: The node source is a draft pull-request candidate, not the exact immutable production image and GitOps configuration.
External ingress, NetworkPolicy, Raft/PVC/snapshot/backup inspection, complete telemetry and support-artifact canary scans, restore evidence, and independent review remain pending.

evidence.environment: Real load-balancer and three-node Raft composition with two organizations and caller-controlled raw keys/prefixes.
assertions: Tenant-scoped prefix-list responses contain no other-tenant values or internal organization prefix.
A caller key shaped like another tenant's internal namespace remains within the caller's namespace and is undiscoverable by the other tenant.
limitations: Partial KV-002 proof: percent/double encoding, Unicode normalization, empty/root prefix, path ACLs, ESO namespace/service-account identity, and exact production ingress remain pending.
The current list route is not proven globally complete across shards; DEN-1517 owns that separate contract and implementation.

evidence.environment: Real process composition exercising the secret client inventory and explicit reveal paths for two organizations.
assertions: Secret inventory exposes safe metadata/name but not the canary secret value or internal organization prefix.
Explicit secret reveal returns the value only to the owning organization and remains absent for another organization.
limitations: Partial redaction proof only; it does not scan production logs, metrics, traces, audit sinks, browser artifacts, exports, support bundles, Raft storage, snapshots, or backups.
ESO/TLS paths, exact release images/configuration, retention window scans, and independent review remain pending.
